# West Coast Capital Mortgage

> Independent mortgage brokerage serving homebuyers, homeowners, and real estate investors in California, Florida, and Texas. We shop wholesale lenders and compare real options for the borrower instead of quoting off a single rate sheet.

West Coast Capital Mortgage Inc. is a licensed brokerage led by Anatoliy Kanevsky, a mortgage and real estate broker based in the Los Angeles area and working across the markets below since 2004. We place conventional, jumbo, FHA, VA, and the full range of non-QM programs (DSCR, bank-statement, foreign-national, investment-property) for both purchases and refinances, and we handle the loan side and, where applicable, the real estate side of a transaction.

- Primary markets: California, Florida, Texas
- Company NMLS #2817729 · CA DRE Corporation License #02440065
- Broker: Anatoliy Kanevsky, NMLS #2775380 · CA DRE #01385024
- Contact: 310-654-1577 · Los Angeles area
- Equal Housing Opportunity. Rates and program availability change; nothing here is a commitment to lend.

## Loan programs
- [Conventional loans](https://westcoastcapitalmortgage.com/conventional-loans): Conforming financing for qualified buyers and homeowners.
- [Jumbo loans](https://westcoastcapitalmortgage.com/jumbo-loans): Financing above conforming limits, including high-balance California and Florida markets.
- [FHA loans](https://westcoastcapitalmortgage.com/fha-loans): Lower-down-payment, flexible-credit government loans.
- [VA loans](https://westcoastcapitalmortgage.com/va-loans): Zero-down financing for eligible veterans and service members.
- [Non-QM loans](https://westcoastcapitalmortgage.com/non-qm-loans): Alternative-documentation loans for borrowers who do not fit conventional guidelines.
- [DSCR loans](https://westcoastcapitalmortgage.com/dscr-loans): Investment-property loans qualified on the property's rental income, not personal income.
- [Bank-statement loans](https://westcoastcapitalmortgage.com/bank-statement-loans): Income qualified from bank deposits, built for self-employed borrowers.
- [Foreign-national loans](https://westcoastcapitalmortgage.com/foreign-national-loans): Financing for non-US-resident buyers, common in Florida and California.
- [Investment-property loans](https://westcoastcapitalmortgage.com/investment-property-loans): Purchase and refinance options for rental and investment real estate.
- [HELOC](https://westcoastcapitalmortgage.com/heloc): Home equity lines for homeowners tapping existing equity.
- [Self-employed borrowers](https://westcoastcapitalmortgage.com/self-employed-borrowers): How business owners and 1099 earners qualify.

## Markets served
- [California](https://westcoastcapitalmortgage.com/california-mortgage-locations): Statewide, with deep coverage of Greater Los Angeles and the South Bay.
- [Florida](https://westcoastcapitalmortgage.com/florida): Jumbo, condo, DSCR, and foreign-national financing.
- [Texas](https://westcoastcapitalmortgage.com/texas): Purchase and refinance financing for Texas borrowers.
